# Planet survey

<!-- data-table: parsed by runtime/research/markdown_data.py; keep one table, one row per entry -->

Every planet of 6000 star systems of galaxy 1 walked from `0x0001DB00F769C14E`, as `find-planets.py` reads it from the generators of the game run in an emulator (build 180836): portal address (planet, system, Y, Z, X), biome, biome subtype, weather, storm frequency, whether the weather is extreme, sentinel level at the normal difficulty preset, then of its system the race, star colour, economy, wealth and conflict level (wealth and conflict `Pirate` mark an outlaw system). Names are the enum names of the game. One system was compared with the running game (docs/PLANET_FINDER_NOTES.md); do not edit by hand.
